summary: Search: the follow-up to the review of requesting from the search page, one commit, re-checked by the same reviewer: all seven lows and three nits resolved as meant and nothing new. Try again shows it is retrying and announces a repeated failure; the page waits for the server's request settings before promising a request and reads them once; arriving matches are announced; focus is placed after each of three moves and the Request button stays focusable while its request is out; a request's answer is told to the app only while the tab still acts as whoever pressed; a refusal for requests being off says so. The status wording now comes from one table that matches what pending, processing and waiting-for-approval mean on the server. Read in a tree that also held the unfinished My requests page; applied here alone, with a tree identical to the commit read.
